title: Per-model KV warmstart scheduling and sequence-cluster performance profiles
creator: Ava Moreno
description:
Goal: produce a per-model onboarding flow that generates sequence-length cluster profiles and automatically recommends
KV warmstart scheduling (pin durations and staggered warmups) to reduce cold-start latency for long-context requests while minimizing memory pressure.

Background: We've observed long-tail cold-start regressions for models with heavy long-context usage. Current kv-profile artifacts include sequence quantiles and retention hints, but we lack a scheduler that converts those profiles into an actionable, per-deployment pin/eviction policy plus a warmstart plan for newly onboarded versions.

Scope:
- Add offline clustering step to profile sequence-length distributions and identify 3 canonical clusters per model (short, mid, long).
- Derive pin-duration recommendations and staggered warmstart orders by cluster weight + model-specific KV size estimates.
- Publish a new artifact format (flat CSV + metadata header) consumed by runtime pin orchestrator and the onboarding UI.
- Implement telemetry hooks to measure warmstart effectiveness (time-to-first-token, first-100-token latency, eviction churn) and feed into a feedback loop for profile tuning.
- Provide a CLI command and Console onboarding page to accept/reject recommended pin schedule and to run a simulated warmstart using sampled workload traces.
acceptance_criteria: Automated profiler produces sequence-cluster profile file for a model (short/mid/long clusters)
Pin schedule generator outputs per-cluster pin durations and an ordered warmstart plan
Runtime can consume the published artifact and execute warmstart ordering without intervention
Observed median first-100-token latency reduced by >=20% in lab long-tail tests for at least two tested models
Console shows recommended schedule and allows user override; changes are reflected in onboarding flow
notes_and_updates: 2026-02-28 - Ava Moreno created ticket. Initial spike suggests sequence clustering using k=3 with log-scaled lengths performs well on RLHF chat traces.
2026-03-03 - Spike: prototype clusterer and export format for 3 models (gpt-xxx variants). Initial pin-duration heuristic: cluster_weight * base_duration * kv_size_factor.
2026-03-05 - Review: PM requested we expose an explicit cost estimate for recommended pins (GPU memory-hours). Added to next iteration.
2026-03-09 - Engineering: implemented runtime consumer that reads CSV header and applies staggered pin order. Integration tests are flaky under low-memory CI; investigating eviction race.
2026-03-12 - Telemetry: added first-100-token and eviction-churn metrics to profiler. Running A/B in staging against 2 models with synthetic long-tail generator.

2026-03-14 - Blocker found: when two versions of same model onboard simultaneously, scheduling needs cross-version coordination to avoid oversubscription. Adding dependency on inter-version admission control task.
next_steps: Add cross-version admission checks to pin scheduler (short-term fix: conservative caps per-host)
Implement cost-estimator piece and surface estimated memory-hours & price in Console onboarding modal
Stabilize CI integration tests by mocking low-memory eviction signals
Run extended staging experiment for 7 days and collect telemetry to validate >=20% latency improvement
